message: card.spec.ts:13 — reads a positional locator written into the read itself in the window the action at line 12 opened
why: The same point by the other road: the index is written into the read itself rather than bound to a name first, so a rule that only followed `const` bindings would pass over it. The hover is the action, the computed border colour is the reading, and nothing between them says the pointer has landed.
